name: spring-switch
title: Spring Switch
description: A spring-loaded switch for on/off settings.
useCases: In profile settings, a user enables notifications. The app saves the flag and restores it on the next visit.
In a layout editor, a user temporarily enables a grid. The local switch tells the canvas when to show its guides.
task: A spring-loaded switch for on/off settings.
behavior: Use defaultChecked for a local switch. For an app-owned preference, pass checked and update it from onCheckedChange.
